facts.text: Snow left Waterhole (5,010 ft) and Buckinghorse (4,850 ft) 22 to 24 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Waterhole
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: May 27 (2023), May 30 (2024), June 1 (2025)

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 13 (2024), June 15 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Waterhole (5,010 ft) and Buckinghorse (4,850 ft).

evidence.name: Waterhole
evidence.detail: 18.8 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 33.8 in (2023), 24.6 in (2024), 35.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: 28.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 54.9 in (2023), 36.2 in (2024), 54.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 8 and July 14, carried from the melt-out dates at Waterhole (5,010 ft) and Buckinghorse (4,850 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Waterhole
evidence.detail: melted out May 8, 1,481 ft below the pass; points to May 1 to July 6

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: melted out May 20, 1,641 ft below the pass; points to May 15 to July 22
